propositions: The .bridge_state cache contributes 92% (approximately 950 MiB) of the 1.04 GiB tickets branch size because baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass fields change on every reconciler pass despite being unread or containing only bookkeeping

Removing baseline_advanced_at reduces marginal git pack cost per bindings.json version from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB (7.4x improvement); moving last_get_pass to a separate get_rotation.json file achieves an additional 12.8x reduction in marginal cost and version count

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/fast-import reduces the existing repository size from 1.17 GiB to 98 MiB (8.4% of original) while preserving all commits and merges and maintaining byte-identical HEAD tree

Reconciler runs on ephemeral runners so .bridge_state must remain committed to the branch; the cache cannot be re-homed off-branch because convergence self-healing already corrects binding drift without requiring stable history location

Implementation requires staged rollout with mixed-version compatibility: moving last_get_pass to a sidecar file while reading max(new, legacy), normalizing baseline text fields, narrowing prev_snapshot.json to a key-set, and introducing an epoch guard to prevent stale clones from merging

Reclaim execution depends on operator-attested quiescence including zero active sessions, all rebar-mcp servers stopped, all writer workflows disabled with verified no in-flight runs, and verified off-repo backup bundles before any history rewrite publication
